landingPage.headline: Real introductions
landingPage.subheadline: Juno introduces you to one real person at a time — never a list, never both sides at once, and only once you both say yes.

demoConversation.text: Hi, I'm Juno. I introduce one real person at a time, never a list.
Tell me about yourself and who you're looking for — I'll find one great match and ask if you're both interested.

features.title: One introduction at a time
features.body: No swiping, no browsing profiles. Juno finds one person who's actually a fit and introduces just them.

features.title: Nothing shared without consent
features.body: Names, photos, and contact details stay private until both sides say yes.

features.title: A real conversation, not a form
features.body: Tell Juno about yourself in chat. It asks the right questions and remembers what matters.

faqs.question: How is this different from a dating app?
faqs.answer: There's no browsing or swiping. Juno introduces you to one person at a time, based on an actual conversation about who you are and who you're looking for.

faqs.question: Will my details be shared right away?
faqs.answer: No. Your name, photo, and contact details stay private until both you and the other person say yes to an introduction.

faqs.question: What if I'm not interested in a suggestion?
faqs.answer: Just tell Juno. It'll keep looking — there's no pressure to say yes to any introduction.

faqs.question: Is Juno free to use?
faqs.answer: Yes, chatting with Juno and getting introductions is free.

contact.heading: Have a question for the team?
contact.body: Juno can answer most questions directly in chat — or reach out to us by email.
